content.short: Octav is a portfolio intelligence platform with automatic NAV reports for digital asset managers.
content.description: Octav tracks digital asset portfolios across 50+ chains and 10,000+ protocols, producing automatic NAV reports, exposure insights and exportable snapshots for compliance. It serves more than 200 digital asset managers and also offers an API. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Octav.
content.meta: Octav offers portfolio tracking and automatic NAV reporting across 50+ chains, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
